subject: general
question: Which of the following former Chief Minister of an Indian state was conferred the Padma Bhushan in 2021 posthumously?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tarun Gogoi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tarun Gogoi was a prominent Indian politician who served as the Chief Minister of Assam for three consecutive terms from 2001 to 2016.
 
• He was a member of the Indian National Congress (INC) and played a significant role in the political landscape of Assam.
 
• Tarun Gogoi was conferred the Padma Bhushan posthumously in 2021 in recognition of his contributions to public affairs.
 
• During his tenure, he was credited with improving the law and order situation in Assam and promoting economic development in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan**

 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, established in 1954 by the Government of India.
 
• It is awarded to recognize distinguished service of a high order in any field including service rendered by government servants.
 
• The award is announced on the occasion of Republic Day every year.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Bhushan are also eligible to use "PB" as a suffix to their name.
 
 
 
• **Indian National Congress (INC)**
 
 
• The Indian National Congress (INC) is one of the two major political parties in India, the other being the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Founded in 1885, the INC played a significant role in the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• Post-independence, the party has governed India for the majority of its history and has produced several Prime Ministers including Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi, and Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• The party's ideology is centered around social democracy and secularism.
 
 
 
• **Assam**
 
 
• Assam is a state in northeastern India, known for its rich culture, diverse population, and scenic beauty.
 
• The state is famous for its tea plantations, silk, and the Brahmaputra River.
 
• Assam has a unique geographical position, sharing borders with Bhutan, Bangladesh, and several Indian states.
 
• The state has a history of political instability and insurgency, which has significantly improved in recent years.
